svg.text: Pickup weapon · misdirection — Black Ledger armory dossier
“Let them shoot the version of you that isn’t there.”
Projects a phantom duplicate of your vehicle
Enemy lock-ons + AI prefer the decoy for 5s
Lens glows; a twin flickers out
A battered decoy projector device, a dented metal
box with a glass lens emitter and an antenna,
Text-to-3D · Symmetry Off · Quad · ~5k tris · PBR 2K
